# Productivity Bundle Skill

Curated by Skill Harbor. This is not a fixed pack that installs everything at once, and it is not a page that only links to other pages. It is a dynamic orchestrator: a single skill that works for you, in plain words, at the moment your work feels messy.

How it works, in order: 1. You say what feels messy, in normal words. No jargon needed. 2. It does a quick check of what better organization means for your case: ideas to sort out, documents to write, a project brief to clarify, or a Git workflow to tidy up. 3. It searches Skill Harbor for skills that fit that need. 4. By default, it only looks for free skills that need no API key, no account, and no payment. That way it works right away, with no setup. 5. It shows you a short list, three to five skills, with what each one does, what it does not do, and its verification status. It never invents a skill and never hides a requirement. 6. It waits for your go before installing anything. Nothing is installed without the list shown first. 7. It installs only what you approved, uses those skills step by step, and then summarizes the result in plain words, with clear next steps.

If you want to go further, say so. Only then, on your explicit word, it can look at connected options: a task tool, a notes tool, or a calendar, for example Asana, Airtable, Notion, or a calendar. Here the opt-in is often an account to connect, not just an API key, and it is you who connects it yourself, in your own environment. It explains that before...
